factual_errors.text: Maximum efficiency = 1.0 (100%). Most real devices are less than this
factual_errors.correction: All real devices have an efficiency less than 1 (100%), because every real energy transfer dissipates some energy to the surroundings. 'Most' suggests some real devices reach 100%. It also contradicts the lesson's own statement in keyPoints[1].keyTerms[1].def: 'always positive in a real device'.

factual_errors.text: Most devices waste some energy, usually as thermal energy (heat) or sound.
factual_errors.correction: All real devices waste some energy. It is usually dissipated by heating the surroundings. Saying 'most' implies some devices waste none. This is inconsistent with the lesson's statement that wasted energy is 'always positive in a real device'.
